clean_data: forward days after registration only, real NQ futures bars from the nightly archive (sessions >= 2026-10-23)

futility.evaluated_on: exactly the first L forward trades (chronological) at look L
futility.calibration: Review 3 proposed CP < 10%. Simulated before any forward data (sd 2.07R, N_max 600): CP < 10% at 100/200/300 trades stops a TRUE +0.08R edge 56% of the time (zero edge 78%) - it barely discriminates. CP < 1% stops a true +0.08R edge 14%, a zero edge 34%, a -0.05R edge 50% within 300 trades. The posterior rule (P < 0.2) practically never fires with the validation at half weight; kept as declared. 300 trades cannot separate 0 from +0.08R well (SE ~0.12R) - this test mostly kills edges that are clearly dead or negative.

validation.note: variant 43 on 2022-01..2026-01; contaminated (post-hoc market choice) -> half weight = variance x2

posterior.forward: mean R per trade with variance sd^2/n, sd = max(sample sd, 1.5)

cusum_kill.series: daily R summed over each forward trade day (days without trades skipped)
cusum_kill.calibration: block-bootstrap of variant 43's 2022-now trade days recentred to +0.08R/trade: false kill about once per 3 years (ARL ~440-470 trade days); a zero edge is killed after a median ~180 trade days
